Package org.checkerframework.framework.util

Class TreePathCacherTest

java.lang.Object
org.checkerframework.framework.util.TreePathCacherTest
public class TreePathCacherTest extends Object
Unit tests for TreePathCacher, checked against the JDK reference implementation TreePath.getPath(CompilationUnitTree, Tree).

These exercise the structural cases that the checker test suites do not target directly:

  • the TreePathCacher.getPath(TreePath, Tree) overload finding a target that is not under the given path's leaf (the out-of-subtree case), and
  • finding a target deep in a class with many top-level members.
A previous "optimization" that narrowed that overload to scan only the leaf's subtree passed NullnessTest but produced wrong results here; this test guards against that regression.

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    absentTreeIsNull()
    Checks that a tree from a different compilation unit is reported (and cached) as not present.
    void
    addArtificialPathMarksTheTree()
    Checks that TreePathCacher.addArtificialPath(com.sun.source.tree.Tree, com.sun.source.util.TreePath) marks the tree as artificial, that the mark survives TreePathCacher.useUnit(com.sun.source.tree.CompilationUnitTree) for the same unit, and that TreePathCacher.clear() drops it.
    void
    firstOverloadMatchesJdk()
    Checks that getPath(CompilationUnitTree, Tree) matches the JDK for every tree, both cold and cached.
    void
    manyLookupsUnderOneLeafMatchJdk()
    Checks that many lookups under the same leaf, enough for TreePathCacher to index the leaf's subtree, match the JDK for targets under the leaf, outside it, and absent from the compilation unit.
    void
    secondOverloadFindsInSubtreeTargets()
    Checks that getPath(TreePath, Tree) returns the correct path for targets under the leaf.
    void
    secondOverloadFindsOutOfSubtreeTargets()
    Checks that getPath(TreePath, Tree) finds a target that is NOT under the given path's leaf: the search expands outward to the whole compilation unit.
    void
    useUnitAfterClearBehavesLikeAFreshCache()
    Checks that after TreePathCacher.clear(), TreePathCacher.useUnit(com.sun.source.tree.CompilationUnitTree) for the unit the cache was used for before clears the cache like for a fresh cache, instead of keeping the entries added after the clear.
    void
    useUnitClearsOnlyForANewUnit()
    Checks that TreePathCacher.useUnit(com.sun.source.tree.CompilationUnitTree) keeps the cache, including the path of a tree that a scan cannot find (an artificial tree), when called again for the same compilation unit, and clears it for another compilation unit.
    void
    useUnitKeepsEntriesForAllCheckersOfAUnit()
    Simulates the checkers of a compound checker, which share one cache and each call TreePathCacher.useUnit(com.sun.source.tree.CompilationUnitTree) when they start a compilation unit: every entry, a registered path, a path found by a scan, and a cached absence, survives the later checkers' calls for the same unit, and none survives the next unit, even when the unit after that is the first one again.
